extraction.Name: James Two Horse or Quigley
extraction.Refused/Protested: No, it was received in the mail and I thought that since it had been issued I was under obligation to take it.
extraction.NOTES: Wife also received a fee patent on her allotment; together they received $9000 for both parcels combined; allottee received cash payment; has wife and three children dependent on him for support; notary public Jas. W. Cross, commission expires 4/28/28 [or 32]; document number 1936 appears at top; subscribed and sworn March 22, 1929
